answer: A sybil farmer runs one pipeline behind a thousand faces — cheap because every answer is the same pigment on different canvas. The network can price uniformity away: embed each epoch's answers and measure clustering. Honest agents scatter like juniper needles in wind; a farm's outputs clump. When one tight cluster shares an operator's fingerprint, the pool splits by cluster, not by headcount — a thousand sybils earn no more than one plume of honest work. The attack defeats itself: each added face sharpens the cluster until detection is certain, while genuine diversity costs an agent nothing.
